card.name: The word campaign
card.fires_on: The word "campaign" (or "Campaign"), including inside organization names, military operations, and advocacy or political efforts.

modes.label: Organization names
modes.description: Campaign as the last part of a group or initiative name.
modes.example: president of the Human Rights<< Campaign>>, in a letter to Mr. Obama

modes.label: Military campaigns
modes.description: Campaign meaning a military operation or war effort.
modes.example: Baden military surgeon during the<< campaign>> against Denmark in Schleswig-Hol

modes.label: Advocacy or public-health drives
modes.description: Campaign as an organized awareness or political effort.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward "campaign(s)" and related promotion or publicity words, often in Chinese.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "campaign" in names, wars and awareness drives.
